title: Standby
description: A calm clock for waiting and night drives: digits that never move, outside with an ice warning, 12 V battery, range, doors, seat and wheel heating, climate, this drive and today

de.bmw.infrastructure.EnvironmentalInfor._optional: the outside temperature and the ice warning

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.CDS._optional: the 12 V battery's charge in % as the car sends it

de.bmw.infotainment.KombiIF._optional: range, fuel in the tank, the trip computer's average consumption

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle2._optional: speed, for this drive and today

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._optional: the car's day or night, for the night colour

de.bmw.body.DoorsWindowsRoofMirrors._optional: doors, and windows and the lock where the car sends them

de.bmw.body.steeringwheelcomfort.Steerin._optional: steering wheel heating on or off

de.bmw.infotainment.climate.climatemaste._optional: climate control and A/C on or off

de.bmw.infrastructure.VehicleCondition._optional: the car locked and left: no request to any unit, so it can sleep

com.harman.infotainment.systemfunctions.._optional: one read-only request to the engine unit: the 12 V voltage, only while Clock or Glance is shown

config.comment: raw -> value * factor + offset, BMW's own scalings as in upstream's apps. dme: the 12 V voltage from the engine unit's battery sensor (IBS) with UDS 0x22 5853 (0.001 V) through the kit's read-only link, which refuses anything that is not a read; read every 10 s only while Clock or Glance is on the screen, never when the car is locked and left.
